rows.title: P2 harness - bunker-qa.sh fresh-install asserts a HARDCODED toolsd artifact: any repo that does not build a binary named toolsd grades fresh-install FAIL on an install rc=0

[P2] bunker-qa.sh makefile-repo native suite defaults to checks-only "make verify" — ci-pass/chaos-resource hit zero-tests/vacuous FAIL (QA-AUGER-1 grader misfire) on repos whose real suite is another target
[P3] bunker-qa.sh collect cannot reach a FINISHED agent after battery ends — per-cell logs lost with the agent user (~35min after launch)

P3 harness - chaos-disconnect INFO detail names TestLiveJevRoutesKnownCases, a test that appears NOWHERE in this run's logs; the leg's real rc=1 is internal/cli (open QA-BUNKER-076-R2) + internal/server env-induced by the cut's own GOSUMDB=off
[P3] QA-BUNKER ids are reused across cycles with different titles/descriptions — same ID appears in multiple tick reports with different work, breaking traceability
[P3] chaos-errorpath ep_probe generic arm runs the npm start command but never actually probes the error path — the arm passes on a healthy repo because the probe target is wrong
